items.title: What Is The Market Seeing In Accenture Stock That You Are Not?
items.summary: Accenture (ACN) produced free cash flow worth 11.7% of its market value over the last twelve months, against 4.4% for the median S&P 500 company. A yield that wide means one of two things: a bargain, or a business the market expects to shrink. Accenture sells its people's time, and the discount is a bet on what AI does to that.

items.summary: International Business Machines (IBM) has given back 12.9% over the past three months and sits at $239.94, about 73% of its 52-week high. items.title: Why IBM and Lockheed Martin Are Bringing Their Quantum Parnership to Switzerland
items.summary: International Business Machines  and  Lockheed Martin  might seem like an unlikely pairing, but the storied tech giant and defense titan share common ground: quantum computing.  The companies are taking their existing partnership a step further with the formation of a quantum innovation hub in Switzerland, IBM and Lockheed announced Thursday.  At the heart of the agreement is the deployment of an IBM Quantum System Two, the latest generation of the company’s flagship quantum computer, which will be accessible to academics, researchers, and enterprises in the country.
